text:
maria: FYI inc-bot stopped issuing PagerDuty pages for the 'severe-prod' route at ~10:23 UTC, observed because PD shows no recent triggers and customers started DMing support.
devon: yikes, do we have any logs from the pagerlink proxy?
ops-bot: saw a 400 from Pagerflow on outbound webhook, header `X-Route-TTL` parsed as empty. quick grep: `/var/log/pagerlink/2026-02-12.log` shows repeated `400 Bad Request` for payloads from inc-bot at 10:23:07 -> 10:26:12.
maria: posting minimal snippet:
```
{"headers": {"X-Route-ID":"severe-prod","X-Route-TTL":""}, "body": {...}}
```
sam: that TTL empty case should never happen, looks like a marshaling change in the inc-bot client. any recent deploys?
maria: inc-bot had a config roll earlier this morning (automated rollout at 09:58). I flipped the canary to 100% at 10:10, based on green checks.
oncall-sre: I'm getting pages manually now, but several alerts missed the automated paging. customer-impact: two paying customers experienced delayed incident notifications for ~12 minutes, support opened 3 tickets.
devon: mitigation: revert inc-bot config to previous release? or patch to add default TTL header in pagerlink proxy. which is faster?
ops-bot: fastest path is proxy-side guard: if `X-Route-TTL` is missing/empty, set `ttl=300` and forward. I'll push a hotfix to edge in 2-3m.
maria: please also add a short-lived monitor: alert if `400` rate from pagerlink > 5/min.
incident-bot: automatic runbook step triggered: "Manual paging" at 10:37 UTC per playbook, recorded by inc-assist.
devon: ops-bot, once hotfix is live can you confirm PD pages resume and post sample request/response?
ops-bot: hotfix deployed to edge at 10:41 (rolled in 30s). observed retries and successful 202s to Pagerflow at 10:42:11. sample: `POST /v1/events 202 Accepted`
sam: good. Can we capture the inc-bot client change that caused empty header? need a revert PR or validation in inc-bot.
maria: I've opened a follow-up issue: https://redwood.internal/ops/ISSUE-2197 with repro and logs. assigning to @devon to cut a patch to inc-bot to enforce header emission.
oncall-sre: cost of impact note for postmortem: delayed customer notifications, ~12m, 3 customers, no data loss. ops actions restored paging automatically, but manual pages were used during mitigation window.
devon: will do a patch and release tomorrow AM; meanwhile I'll add a client-side assert to avoid empty TTL.
maria: thanks. closing live coordination. we'll start a short RCA doc and postmortem following the usual template. :thumbsup:
